title: All in one go

objectives.label: Join two things you can say
objectives.descriptorEN: Weld where you're from onto what you speak with 'in', and say it as one sentence.

objectives.label: Say who you are in one go
objectives.descriptorEN: Join your name to where you're from — 'Sem ___ in sem iz ___.' — with no gap between them.

objectives.label: Head off a misunderstanding
objectives.descriptorEN: Warn her before she starts: 'Nisem iz Slovenije in ne govorim dobro slovensko.'

frameEN: Slavko is already recording when you get there.
He's sending a voice message to his grandma, and she wants to hear you.
Today you learn to join two things you can already say into one sentence.

n1.speaker: npc
n1.sl: Čakaj, snemam za babico! Vedno vpraša: Od kod si? Jaz ji rečem: Sem iz Ljubljane. Daj, povej ji še ti!
n1.en: Hang on, I'm recording for my grandma! She always asks: Where are you from? I tell her: I'm from Ljubljana. Go on, you tell her too!
n1.deliverySL: [hushed, mid-recording] Čakaj, snemam za babico! [imitating her] Vedno vpraša: Od kod si? [plainly, into the phone] Jaz ji rečem: Sem iz Ljubljane. [inviting] Daj, povej ji še ti!

stallHandlers.label: Tell her where you're from — your country's name in English is fine

n2.speaker: npc
n2.sl: Potem vpraša: A govoriš slovensko? Reci ji: Govorim slovensko.
n2.en: Then she asks: Do you speak Slovene? Tell her: I speak Slovene.
n2.deliverySL: [still recording] Potem vpraša: A govoriš slovensko? [encouraging] Reci ji: Govorim slovensko.

n3.speaker: npc
n3.sl: Babica ne čaka. Zato takole: Sem Slavko in sem iz Ljubljane.
n3.en: Grandma doesn't wait. So, like this: I'm Slavko and I'm from Ljubljana.
n3.deliverySL: [quick, imitating her pace] Babica ne čaka. [clearly, into the phone] Zato takole: Sem Slavko in sem iz Ljubljane.
n3.slowSL: Babica ne čaka … Zato takole … Sem Slavko … in sem iz Ljubljane.
n3.deliverySlowSL: [quick, imitating her pace] Babica ne čaka … [slower, clearly] Zato takole … [very slowly, enunciating every syllable] Sem Slavko … [very slowly, enunciating every syllable] in sem iz Ljubljane.

n4.speaker: npc
n4.sl: Vmes je ena mala beseda. And. Daj, vprašaj me!
n4.en: There's one little word in the middle there. 'And'. Go on, ask me!
n4.deliverySL: [conspiratorial] Vmes je ena mala beseda. [in English, plainly] And. [inviting] Daj, vprašaj me!

n5.speaker: npc
n5.deliverySL: [delighted] And? To je in. [savouring, clearly] In.
n5.deliverySlowSL: [delighted] And? … [slower, deliberately] To je … [very slowly, drawn out] in … [very slowly, drawn out] In.

n6.speaker: npc
n6.sl: Zdaj pa ti, vse skupaj: Sem iz Ljubljane in govorim slovensko.
n6.en: Now you, all in one go: I'm from Ljubljana and I speak Slovene.
n6.deliverySL: [warmly, handing it over] Zdaj pa ti, vse skupaj: [clearly] Sem iz Ljubljane in govorim slovensko.

stallHandlers.label: Where you're from and what you speak — one sentence

n6.slowSL: Zdaj pa ti, vse skupaj … Sem iz Ljubljane … in govorim slovensko.
n6.deliverySlowSL: [warmly, handing it over] Zdaj pa ti, vse skupaj … [very slowly, enunciating every syllable] Sem iz Ljubljane … [very slowly, enunciating every syllable] in govorim slovensko.

c4.speaker: client
c4.en: I'm from ___ and I speak Slovene.

audio.heard: Sem iz Ljubljane in govorim slovensko.

n7.speaker: npc
n7.en: Ha, great! Grandma will be pleased.

n8.speaker: npc
n8.sl: Še ime! Poslušaj: Sem Slavko in sem iz Ljubljane.
n8.en: Your name, too! Listen: I'm Slavko and I'm from Ljubljana.
n8.deliverySL: [remembering] Še ime! [clearly] Poslušaj: Sem Slavko in sem iz Ljubljane.

stallHandlers.label: Your name, then 'in', then where you're from

c5.speaker: client
c5.en: My name is ___ and I'm from ___.

audio.heard: Sem Slavko in sem iz Ljubljane.

n9.speaker: npc
n9.sl: Pazi! Babica bo mislila, da vse razumeš. In potem bo govorila hitro!
n9.en: Careful! Grandma will think you understand everything. And then she'll talk fast!
n9.deliverySL: [mock alarm] Pazi! Babica bo mislila, da vse razumeš. [speeding up, breathless] In potem bo govorila hitro!

n9b.speaker: npc
n9b.sl: Zato ji reci takole: Nisem iz Slovenije in ne govorim dobro slovensko.
n9b.en: So tell her this: I'm not from Slovenia and I don't speak Slovene well.
n9b.deliverySL: [helpfully, leaning in] Zato ji reci takole: [clearly] Nisem iz Slovenije in ne govorim dobro slovensko.
n9b.slowSL: Zato ji reci takole … Nisem iz Slovenije … in ne govorim dobro slovensko.
n9b.deliverySlowSL: [helpfully, slowly] Zato ji reci takole … [very slowly, enunciating every syllable] Nisem iz Slovenije … [very slowly, enunciating every syllable] in ne govorim dobro slovensko.

stallHandlers.label: Warn her: not from Slovenia, and you don't speak it well

c6.speaker: client
c6.sl: Nisem iz Slovenije in ne govorim dobro slovensko.
c6.en: I'm not from Slovenia and I don't speak Slovene well.

n10.speaker: npc
n10.sl: Ha, potem bo počasi! Babica vedno reče: Hvala in adijo.
n10.en: Ha, then she'll go slowly! Grandma always says: Thanks and bye.
n10.deliverySL: [laughing] Ha, potem bo počasi! [warmly] Babica vedno reče: Hvala in adijo.

stallHandlers.label: Close the message: thanks and bye
